literal: Love let go of either one, or modesty let go, O good heart! As for me, I cannot bear these two.
translation: O my good heart, either give up desire or give up modesty; as for me, I cannot endure both at the same time.
modern: நல்ல நெஞ்சே! காமத்தை விட்டுவிடு அல்லது நாணத்தை விட்டுவிடு. என்னால் இந்த இரண்டையும் ஒன்றாகத் தாங்கிக்கொள்ள முடியாது.
explanation: In this couplet, the heroine addresses her own heart, which is caught in a painful conflict. She is torn between her intense love (kāmam) and her sense of modesty (nāṇ), which prevents her from seeking her lover. She tells her heart to choose one and abandon the other, as she cannot bear the burden of holding onto both opposing feelings simultaneously. The word 'poṟēn' highlights her inability to endure this internal struggle any longer.
